Commentary.Commentary: With Williamson absent, it will be extremely difficult to hang around. They have an irritating 20-minute session coming up, which is very nervy for all batsmen, with lunch scheduled around the corner. Stay tuned...
India will aim to pick up at least a wicket or two before Lunch. The Kiwis will have to get to their basics and try and see off the new ball first.

Ideally, a team would love to see its opposition to get bowled out under 320 after being asked to bowl first. But this is not a flat deck and as we have been seeing since yesterday, batting has not been easy.

The Kiwis were not at their best with the ball this morning. The lines were not probing enough and not consistent either. The pitch looks like it is getting some turn and bounce and the Black Caps have their hands full.

A respectable score put up by India. They added 77 runs this morning for the loss of 3 wickets. Saha and Jadeja saw off the opening hour with ease and then the former did well to get to his half century.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Henry has taken a blinder. Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Shami goes for the pull shot but doesn't connect it that well. The ball goes towards fine leg where Henry sprints to his right and flies to take a stunning catch. The Kiwi fielders have been terrific on the field and with that, India's first innings comes to an end as they've ended up on 316!
Back of a length ball on off, Shami pushes it to cover-point.
Around off, Shami pushes it to covers.
OUCH! Banged in short on middle and leg, Shami goes after it but gets hit on the helmet. That's hit firmly onto his grill. Shami is fine though.
EDGED! FOUR! Length ball on off, Shami tries to poke but gets a thick outside edge through the gap between slip and gully. The ball races away to the fence and Shami gets a boundary.
TRENT BOULT is back.
Short of a length ball outside off, Saha goes for the pull but misses.
Low full toss around off, Shami pushes it towards covers. Just beats the fielder for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Saha plays it through point for a single.
Full ball outside off, Saha mistimes it out towards mid-wicket. Henry himself runs towards the ball and Saha denies the single.
Length ball outside off, Wriddhiman leaves it alone.
In the corridor outside off, Saha shoulders his arms.
MATT HENRY returns.
Fuller length ball outside off, Shami goes for the big shot over the bowler's head but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Wide outside off, Shami pokes at it but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Played through point by Wriddhiman for a single.
Full on off, Saha pushes it to covers.
Landed outside off, Shami plays it through point for a single.
FOUR! More runs, this time it's Shami! Short of a length ball on middle and leg, stays low, Shami swivels it to fine leg for a boundary.
3rd Test fifty for Wriddhiman Saha!

SIX! Even better! Around off, Saha lofts it over long off and the ball goes all the way for a biggie. That brings up his fifty as well. What a terrific knock so far. His captain Virat Kohli applauds him too. 300 UP FOR INDIA!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full on off, nice flight, Saha clears his front leg and lofts it towards long on for a boundary this is good batting.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, Saha defends it from within his crease.
On the pads, Saha paddles it to the fine leg region. Wagner in the deep does well to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Tossed up around off, Saha defends it into the ground.
Shortish and down the leg side, Shami tries to work but misses.
Length ball around off, Shami gets onto his front foot and defends.
Length ball on the pads, Wriddhiman half-pulls it to long leg for a single. Some words are being exchanged here. Actually Wagner kept on saying something and Saha just gave him the look.
Good length ball outside off, Saha shoulders his arms.
FOUR! That's a poor delivery, dishes out a full toss outside off, Saha pushes it through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Saha drives it through the cover region for a couple.
FOUR! Tad short outside off, Shami goes onto his back foot and cuts it late. The ball goes off the outside edge through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Shami tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
MOHAMMED SHAMI is the last man in.
DRINKS BREAK.

OUT! LBW! Given this time. Although, this looked like a benefit of doubt could have been given to the batsman. The arm ball, around middle, Kumar comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the front pad. Santner appeals and this time the umpire raises his finger! The ball still had some distance to go and could have missed the leg stump.

LBW APPEAL TURNED DOWN! That looked very close. Full and around off, Kumar looks to play the sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Santner appeals but umpire Tucker shakes his head. That looked like it might have crashed into the stumps.
Outside off, pushed to point.
Landed outside off, defended from the crease.
A bouncer to end the over, Wriddhiman ducks.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.
A bouncer now, Saha ducks.
Keeps the length a bit fuller, outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Short again, outside off, Bhuvneshwar arches back and attempts a flashy upper cut but misses.
A short ball around off, from around the wicket, gets extra bounce, Kumar hops to keep it down.
Outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it beautifully over covers for a boundary. Saha moves to 33 now.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
Wider outside off now, left alone.
Landed outside off this time, Saha pushes at it but is beaten by the turn and bounce.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Awesome! What a way to get off the mark. This man can bat. Full and outside off, slightly wide, Kumar leans and drives it behind point for a boundary!
A short ball on middle, Bhuvi just about keeps it down to the leg side.
A bouncer on middle, Bhuvneshwar ducks.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR walks in at number 10, replacing Jadeja.

OUT! Caught! Wagner breaks the dangerous-looking stand. A short ball around middle, Jadeja pulls it away but cannot keep it down. It goes straight down the throat of Matt Henry at deep backward square leg who makes no mistake. Wagner gets his second. Jadeja departs, he was not looking comfortable this morning.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. The batsmen think about the second but decide against it.
Around middle, defended towards short leg.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple. The stand moves to 40 from 71 balls.
Expectedly quicker and flatter, around leg, Ravindra stays back to defend.

SIX! High and handsome! Did not quite connect it cleanly but has enough on it to get the desired result. Flighted on middle, Jadeja comes down the track and swings hard. He puts in a bit more power and gets more height than required but just gets it over the mid-wicket ropes. Moves to 12.
Shorter on middle, Jadeja goes back and works it towards square leg.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.

Time for spin. MITCHELL SANTNER has been called on to bowl. Tom Latham gets his pads on to field at short leg. India have done extremely well to deny the Kiwi speedsters any wicket with the second new ball this morning.
Full and wide outside off, Saha leans and drives it through the covers. There is a fielder in the deep, so just a single available.
Full and straight, defended towards mid off.
Landed outside off, angling away, WS shoulders arms.
Outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Loose from Wriddhiman. Wagner dishes this slightly wider outside off, fuller in length, Saha is drawn into the drive but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Full and on middle, swinging in, Saha is stoic in defense.
NEIL WAGNER comes on to bowl now.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a couple. The stand is worth 30 now.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Short and wide outside off, RJ looks to cut, then tries to pull out of the stroke.
Pitched outside leg, Ravindra misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. Henry thinks of appealing but then bails out.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.

Wild shot. Reckless. Unnecessary. Full and around off, Jadeja has a wild hack and misses. India have done well this morning, not looking uncomfortable, so not quite sure why this came. They have added 20 runs in 6 overs so far.
A bouncer around middle, Saha ducks again.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
A short ball around leg, WS tries to leave it alone, but is hit around the rib cage.
A bouncer now, Wriddhiman ducks.
Full and around off, a bit closer than the previous one, not played at again.
Neil Wagner is warming up...
On a good length around off, angling away, left alone.
On a good length around middle, Jadeja ducks.
Full and outside off, WS pushes at it and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat wide of mid on. The batsmen take a single.
A bouncer on middle, Wriddhiman ducks.
Full on middle and leg, clipped straight to short mid-wicket.
A nice yorker, around off, Saha looks to push it away but ends up digging it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, pushed towards short extra cover.
FOUR LEG BYES! Ends the over with a poor delivery, full and down the leg side, Jadeja misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Short ball again, RJ looks to hook but misses. Boult has a smile on his face. Some plan being worked out...
One more short ball, Jadeja is getting a good working over here, looks to fend it away but barely manages to push it to the off side.
Another short ball, with a bit more venom, Ravindra leaps and sways away from the line.
That cuts him into two! Banged in short around off, Jadeja looks to defend but the ball comes back in a long way and goes just above the stumps.
Landed around middle, tucked wide of mid on for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Saha opens the face of the bat at the last moment and guides it past second slip to third man! The stand moves to 21 from 33 balls.
Full and straight, watchfully defended to the off side.
OUCH! That would have hurt. A short ball around off, Saha looks to duck but the ball barely bounces. He is caught off guard and is hit flush just above the left elbow.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, a touch wide, Jadeja drives this uppishly and the ball goes to point. The fielder is pretty deep so the ball does not carry.
Full and around middle and off, defended towards mid on.
Slightly short in length, punched through gully where one of the fielders dives to his left to stop. There are two men placed in the gully position with a point as well.
Full on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple. Gets off the mark.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Uppish again. Full and wide outside off, Saha leans to drive and gets a thickish outside edge which goes uppishly but is wide of point. There is a man in the deep and the batsmen get a couple. Moves to 21.
Full and outside off, WS pushes forward awkwardly and mistimes it to short mid-wicket.
Tests his footwork and bangs it in the middle of the pitch, the batsman ducks.
This one comes in, Wriddhiman tentatively pushes forward and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
That is a beauty! Around a fuller length outside off, Saha comes forward to defend but the ball moves away to just beat the outside edge.
MATT HENRY to bowl from the other end.
Full and outside off, Saha pushes it through the covers and takes a quick single by the time Martin Guptill gets to his right to stop the ball.
Wide outside off, left alone.
IN THE AIR...SAFE! Full and wide outside off, WS leans to play another cover drive but gets a thick outside edge which lands just short of Tom Latham at gully.
Swings this down the leg side, Wriddhiman misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball goes past short leg towards leg gully.
FOUR! Awesome! Terrific start for India on Day 2. Half volley outside off, Saha leans and executes a beautiful cover drive and gets a boundary. The stand moves to 12 from 14 balls.
A bouncer to start off proceedings, around middle and leg, Saha sways away.

Out walk the overnight batsmen, Wriddhiman Saha and Ravindra Jadeja. TRENT BOULT to start off proceedings to Saha.  Stephen Fleming rings the bell and we are all ready for the game to resume. Here we go...

India will be a bit disappointed with their batting. They would have wanted to capitalize on the massive partnership between Pujara and Rahane but lost their way. However, they will feel they are on top, if they get to 300 or closer.

Matt Henry was the star for New Zealand yesterday as he dismissed both openers and then got Ashwin as well towards the end of the day. Trent Boult was struggling in the heat and was going on and off the field, not being at his best. Mitchell Santner was probing while Jeetan Patel got some turn and bounce later in the day.

86 overs bowled, 239 runs scored and 7 wickets taken. As expected, there is not much to choose between India and New Zealand after the completion of the opening day of the second Test at Eden Gardens. The Kiwis started off well but then the home side fought back before the visitors did well in the final session to gain a slight edge. Can they restrict the hosts to under 270 today? Or will India get to 300 which is a competitive score on this track? Hello and a warm welcome to the second day of the second Test between India and New Zealand at Eden Gardens.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...
The first hour will be critical tomorrow. 300 can turn out to be a competitive total on this track. Do join us tomorrow at 0930 IST for Day 2 of the Test match. Till then, goodbye and take care.

India won't be too disappointed with their efforts and will look to get as many as possible tomorrow. On the other hand, the Kiwi bowlers would look to run through the lower order of India as the pitch is on the uneven side and run scoring won't be easy on it. All in all, it was a mixed day and it can be said that it has been shared by both the teams.

Earlier in the day, Matt Henry and Trent Boult made good use of the moisture in the wicket and dismissed the top order of India cheaply. After that, the duo of Pujara and Rahane came together and stitched together a partnership of 141 runs. They gave a solid foundation to the Indian innings.

Rohit Sharma was dismissed cheaply as Jeetan Patel sent him back to the hut. There was a spring in his stride after he took the wicket of Rohit and after that he dismissed the well set Rahane soon. Ashwin was playing a solid knock but Henry came back with the second new ball and took his wicket to put India on the back foot.

New Zealand have bounced back well in the final session of the day as they grabbed four wickets. India tried to press on and up the ante but couldn't build on it as Pujara handed a soft dismissal to Wagner after playing a brilliant knock of 87. The pitch has started to play tricks and we are only through the first day. The Kiwi bowlers have bowled with discipline and fire and have got the rewards.
The umpires are out with their light meter again and take another reading. They decide that the light is not good enough for play and call it STUMPS ON DAY 1.
On a length angling across Jadeja who stands tall and punches it towards covers.

Fuller length delivery on middle, Jadeja camps back and pushes it back to the bowler. The bowler in his followthrough gets a fingertip to it and the ball hits the stumps at the non striker's end but Saha is safely in. There is a stifled appeal by the bowler but in vain!

Close call! On a good length pitched around leg stump, Jadeja looks to clip it but plays down the wrong line and is rapped low on the pads. There is a loud shout for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it pitched just outside leg stump and Jadeja survives!
On a length wide outside off, Jadeja is watchful as he leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, Jadeja has nothing to do with it.
On a length angling across Jadeja. He lets it go through to the keeper.
The floodlights are on and the umpires are checking the light with the lightmeter.
FOUR! Delightful shot! Fullish delivery outside off, Saha extends his arms and creams it through the covers for a gorgeous noundary.
On a length around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
On a length angling across Saha. He leaves it alone.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Full length delivery directed at the stumps, Saha off drives it superbly and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, Saha looks to flick but gets an inside edge on to his pads and towards the leg side.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! Henry strikes with the new ball! On a good length coming in with the angle. Ashwin stays in the crease and looks to flick it but plays down the wrong line and misses and is rapped on the knee roll. The Kiwis make a loud appeal in unison and the umpire obliges and rules it out. Ashwin was looking good out there but he departs!
FOUR! That's a classy shot! On a length outside off, Ashwin stands tall and punches it with perfect timing and finds the gap in the covers for a gorgeous boundary.
On a length outside off, Ashwin defends it with an angled blade towards point.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ashwin drives it sweetly to the covers.
Straying on the pads, tucked nicely through square leg for a couple.
Good yorker that is hurled in just outside off stump, Ashwin is alert to it and digs it out.
Bouncer! Dug in short, Saha ducks under it with good technique and evades it.
Outside off, left alone by Saha.
On a length directed at the stumps, Saha is right behind it and defends it.
On a good length fired in at the stumps, lifts a bit from the pitch as Saha is suprised and fends it off towards the leg side.
FOUR BYES! Bouncer! Oh! That was weird. Dug in short, nips sideways as Saha looks to duck under it but the ball passes wide of him down the leg side and beats the keeper and through to the boundary.
Back of a length delivery angling across Saha as he leaves it with good technique. This one bounced more. The wicket has already started playing tricks!
Fullish delivery around off, Ashwin prods forward and pushes it gently towards the covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length outside off, Ashwin pokes at it and is beaten by the low bounce.
Good length delivery outside off, stays a bit low. Ashwin shoulders his arms to let that one through. That was bowled at a speed of 134 kmph but still stayed low.
On a length directed at the stumps, Ashwin covers the line well and defends towards the off side.
Poor delivery to start with. Full in length and wide outside off, Ashwin is not bothered to play at that one.
Matt Henry to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Back of a length delivery angling across Saha as he stands tall and defends it with an angled blade towards gully.
Pacy delivery outside off, Saha shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Fullish delivery angling across Saha as he lunges forward and defends solidly.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
On a length around off, Ashwin camps back and pushes it towards the covers.
Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, Ashwin drives it towards mid off.
Trent Boult comes back into the attack.
Second new ball has been taken.
Bowls a leg spinner this time, Saha picks it up and defends it towards point.
SIX! That's the first biggie of the match! Tossed up around middle, Saha has his dancing shoes on and lifts it aerially over deep mid-wicket and the ball clears the boundary easily.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball outside off, Saha watches it closely and lets it go through.
Loopy delivery, Saha prods forward in defence.
A tad short outside off, Ashwin stays back and cuts it through point for a single.
Ashwin drives it with the spin through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery, Ash is solid in his defence.
FOUR! Delightful shot! Tossed up outside off, Ashwin leans into the drive and creams it through the covers for a gorgeous boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Lucky for Ashwin! Tossed up outside off, Ashwin stays back and tries to cut it late but instead gets a bottom edge and the ball whizzes in between the keeper and first slip and races to the boundary.
FOUR! Helped on its way! Around middle and leg, Ashwin stays back and nudges it behind square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Quick throuh the air and outside off, Saha leaves it alone.
Wriddhiman Saha to bat next.

OUT! The well set Rahane departs for a brilliant knock of 77 runs. Quicker and flatter through the air, holds its line. Rahane plays for the spin and misses it completely and is rapped low on the pads. The Kiwis appeal in unison and the umpire has no hesitation in ruling that out. That looked quite adjacent to the naked eye and would have probably crashed into the leg stump. New Zealand are clawing their way back into the match.
Floated up around off, driven towards the covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Tossed up on off, holds its line. Ashwin plays for the spin and gets an outside edge behind point for a single. 200 up for India.
Flighted delivery, Rahane is solid in his defence.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower through the air, driven back to the bowler.
A bit flatter in length and on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around middle, worked towards the leg side.
Full around middle and leg, Rahane presses forward and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ashwin drives it with the spin towards mid on.
Around middle on a length, tucked nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Flighted ball outside off, Ashwin camps back and pushes it towards the covers.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Ashwin stays in the crease and defends solidly.
Tossed up on leg stump, Ashwin stays back and helps it towards the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around middle and off, Rahane is solid in his defence.
Almost an action replay of the previous delivery.
Slow through the air on off, pushed towards the cover region.
Similar delivery, Rahane lunges forward and defends.
Floated up on off, pushed gently towards the covers.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery, Rahane prods forward in defence.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, defended towards the leg side.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Ashwin lets it go through the keeper.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the new man in.

OUT! Sharma departs! Tossed up around middle, spinning in and having a little bit of extra bounce on it as Sharma looks to defend it. He is beaten by the extra bounce and only manages to get an inside edge on to his thigh pad and the ball lobs towards Latham at short leg who pouches it safely. New Zealand are coming back into the match.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated up on off, defended towards short leg.
Rohit Sharma has landed hard on his shoulder while getting back to the crease and seems to be in pain. The physio is attending to him.

Hesitation in running between both the batsmen. Tossed up around middle and off, Rahane defends it towards short mid-wicket. Rohit sets off for a run from the other end but is sent back and he dives in to get back to the crease. That was a wayward throw there, would have been close if it hit.
Floated up on off, pushed gently towards the cover region.
Loopy delivery around middle, Rahane stays back and defends.
Full toss outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner into the attack again.

Drinks are on the field. After putting up a great fight in the second session and first half of this session. India just lost the wicket of Cheteshwar Pujara. The Kiwis did well to pick up a wicket and break the mammoth partnership brewing between Rahane and Pujara. Let's see, how the things pan out in this second half of the session.
Tad short on middle and off, defended off his back foot to the cover-point.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to covers.
Angles in a full ball from wide outside off, Sharma deep in his crease plays it to the off side.
Serves it fuller and wide outside off, Rohit sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Off the mark Rohit! Length ball outside off, Rohit stays tall and punches it through covers for a brace.
Serves it fuller on off, Rahane defended off his front foot.
FOUR! Glanced away! Bowls it down the leg side, Rahane glances it fine to long leg for a speedy boundary.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Rahane sweeps it and it falls just short of the square leg fielder.
Serves it on off, blocked neatly.
A stifled appeal is put down.  Serves it around leg stump. Rahane misses his flick shot and gets hit on the pads. The Kiwis appeal for an LBW but is turned down.
Bowls it down on middle and leg, Rahane plays it back to the bowler.
Angles in a full ball and Rohit does well and defends it to covers.
A good length ball outside off, Sharma sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rohit lets it through to the keeper.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rohit steers it to the gully fielder.
Rohit Sharma is the new man in.

OUT! Pujara throws his wicket away! Full ball outside off, a scoring opportunity for him. He goes for a drive but ends up playing it straight into the hands of Guptill at short cover. The stand of 141 is finally broken and Pujara misses out on another ton. Wagner gets the crucial breakthrough.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball on off, driven through covers for a brace. The fielder does well to stop the ball in the deep.
On middle and leg worked to mid-wicket.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.
Serves it full around middle and off, Rahane blocks it.
Tossed up ball around off, Pujara shimmies to the pitch of the ball and plays it to mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angles in a full ball, defended neatly.
Back of a length ball on the sixth stump line. The sensible Rahane leaves it for the keeper.
FOUR! Edge and runs! Length ball outside off, Rahane strides forward to push at it but the ball goes off an outside edge just past the gully fielder. Two in two for Jinx!
FOUR! Full outside off, Rahane off his front foot squeezes it through square of the wicket for a well-struck boundary. Exquisite stuff!
Hurls a length ball on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Punched away! Short ball outside off, Pujara gets back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Short ball around off, punched to the covers for a single.
The batsman charges down the wicket. They pick up a single.
Bowls it full on off, Rahane punches it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Neatly done! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Rahane shimmies to the pitch of the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
TWO BYES! Bowls it down the leg side, it beats the batsman and the keeper. The umpire signals it as byes. Brace taken.
Jeetan Patel to bowl next.
Hurls a fuller one outside off, Pujara lets it through.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Deliberate! Length ball outside off, Pujara waits for it and opens the face of the bat to run it fine to third man boundary. The ball falls just short of Taylor at gully.
FOUR! Glorious! Back of a length ball outside off, Pujara punches it through point for a boundary.
Angles in a full ball and Pujara drives it to covers.
Almost a wicket! Bowls it around leg stump. The ball keeps a tad low after pitching. Rahane misses his flick shot and so does the keeper. The umpire signals it as byes. Brace taken.
A touch short outside off, Pujara punches it to covers and scurries for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full ball on the pads, Pujara puts away the rubbish ball to long leg fence for a boundary.
Full ball outside off, Rahane leaves it.
Fuller ball on the pads, Rahane flicks it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane strides forward and blocks it to covers.
Serves a full ball outside off, Pujara lets it through.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Pujara sets back and plays it to mid-wicket.
Serves it outside off, Pujara leaves it.
Back of a length ball on the sixth stump line. Pujara sees it go behind the stumps.
Angles in a fuller ball from wide outside off, Pujara drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Wagner back on.
Bouncer outside off, Boult presses hard by putting in extra effort. Rahane lets it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Bowls a fuller ball outside off, Rahane strides forward and blocks it.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Rahane shuffles across and defends it to the leg side.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Rahane sees it and lets it through to the keeper.
Serves it full on middle and off, Rahane defends it neatly.
Serves it full and wide outside off, Rahane plays it to the off side.
Boult back on.
Bouncer to end the over! Short on middle and leg, Pujara ducks in to let that pass over him.
Full ball on middle and off, Pujara stands tall and drives it to mid off for no runs.
A touch fuller on middle and leg, Pujara pushes it to mid on.

... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...

The game is in balance at the moment and India would look to press forward when they come out to bat in the final session. The Kiwi bowlers need to come back harder and break this threatening partnership. Do join us for the post Tea session as it promises to be an enticing contest between bat and ball.

Mitchell Santner and Jeetan Patel extracted some spin and bounce from the pitch but weren't able to put the set pair in any sort of real trouble. Trent Boult and Neil Wagner bend their backs and tried their best but the juice had faded away from the pitch. Pujara and Rahane played the ball on its merit and put away to the loose deliveries with utmost ease.

It has been a session which has completely belonged to India as Pujara and Rahane have sailed through the proceedings nonchalantly. 31 overs and 79 runs scored in this session. India have fought back nicely.

... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Talking about the Kiwis, they have been prolific so far. They have bowled well, fielded better and took on the opposition. Matt Henry has been the pick of the bowlers with his brilliant spell. Trent Boult did well to take the valuable wicket of Virat Kohli too. Overall, all the bowlers did well to keep the scoring tight for India. Let's see how they pan out their plan in the second session. Do join us shortly.

Cheteshwar Pujara is playing with all his talent and experience out there as he is playing some quality shots. Ajinkya Rahane has just joined him in the middle. They both did well to negotiate the first session and will like to go from strength to strength post Lunch. The former got a lucky break when Taylor missed a catching opportunity and he will like to get a big score and make the Kiwis pay.

That is the end of the opening session. What a display of cricket we have seen here so far. After opting to bat first, Shikhar Dhawan dragged one on to Matt Henry cheaply in the second over of the match. Then the duo of Murali Vijay and Cheteshwar Pujara did well to put some resistance but Henry once again struck and Vijay departed too. The Indian skipper Virat Kohli flopped again as he went on to chase a full ball and gave away his wicket to Trent Boult.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Low full toss outside off, width on offer. A juicy ball and Pujara drives it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Serves it on the pads, Pujara neatly flicks it to mid-wicket.
Bowls it down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick it but is beaten.
Angles away a length ball outside off, Pujara leaves it for the keeper.
Neil Wagner to bowl now.
Peach! Angles in a length ball, Vijay is beaten on his back foot defence.
Couldn't find the gap! Full ball around off, Vijay off his back foot punches it to covers.
Angles in a length ball from wide outside off, Vijay with a steady balance defends it off his front foot.
Perfect length ball on off, Vijay strides forward and defends it neatly.
FOUR! Punched away! Length ball on the sixth stump line, Vijay deep in his crease punches it through covers for a well-placed boundary.
Bouncer on middle and off, Vijay lets it to Watling.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Awesome shot! Angles away a full ball outside off, Pujara launches on it and drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Short ball outside off, Pujara leaves it for the keeper.
Another full ball around off, Pujara strides forward and blocks it yet again with his front pad.
Pujara gets lucky! Length ball around off. It swings in after pitching. Pujara comes forward and tries to block it but the ball hits the pad and the appeal for LBW is turned down by the umpire.
Full ball outside off, Pujara who likes to play off his front foot defends it to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, Vijay off his front foot sways away on that to let it pass him.
Serves it full on middle and off, Vijay defends it to the off side.
On the pads, played fine to long leg for a single.
What a bounce on that! Bowls it outside off, it goes on to bounce a bit extra and the keeper does well to stop that as Pujara left that.
Perfect length ball outside off, Pujara lets it through.
Length ball on the stumps, played to the off side.
Bowls it from around the wicket and it is a full ball. Vijay defends it to covers.
Full ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Serves it wide outside off, Murali leaves it to the keeper.

Almost a wicket! Hurls a length ball around leg and goes on to hit the back pad of Vijay. He is completely beaten while he tries to block that. The appeal for LBW is up and roaring but the umpire turns it down. Maybe the ball pitched outside leg. Vijay survives that beautiful ball.
Back of a length ball on the sixth stump line, Vijay leaves it for the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, Vijay sees it and leaves it for the keeper.
Henry pulls back his length a bit and Pujara lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Even better! Length ball on middle and off, Pujara draws himself on front foot and drives it past mid off for the second boundary of this over. Pure delight as he hit that shot.
FOUR! Flicked away! Fuller ball on middle and leg, Pujara who is so good in his balance flicks it though mid-wicket for a  superb boundary.
A good length ball outside off, it hits the deck hard and bounces a bit. Pujara gets onto his front foot and is beaten yet again.
Short ball on middle and off, Pujara sways away in time and lets it through to the keeper.
Perfect ball around off, Pujara is beaten as he tries to poke at it.
Length ball on middle and off, Vijay off his front foot tries to defend and is hit on the pads. A half-hearted appeal is put down.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Vijay sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Bowls an away swinging ball. Vijay sees it early and leaves it to the keeper.
Perfect length ball outside off, Vijay lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Classical! Fuller ball outside off, Vijay leans on to it and drives it nonchalantly through covers for the first boundary of this match.
Full ball on off, defended to the off side.
Hurls a length ball around off, Pujara strides forward and blocks it to the off side.
Low full toss around off, Pujara stays on front foot and punches it to mid on. Good save there by the fielder.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg. Pujara stays tall and works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball around middle and off, Pujara off his front foot drives it to cover.
On middle and leg, Vijay flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Serves it on the pads, Pujara tries to play at it but it goes off the pads to third man for a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Full ball on off, driven to covers.
Yorker on middle, Vijay pushes it to the leg side.
Full ball around off, pushed to mid-wicket.
Another close call! Inswinging length ball from outside off, Murali strides forward and tries to defend. The ball hits the pad and it goes to the slips. A half-hearted appeal is turned down.

That was close! Boult swings in a length ball from around off. Murali off his front foot defends it. The ball hits the bat and then pad. It squirts just in front of the track. In his followthrough, Trent dives forward to catch it but fails.
Peach! Length ball around off, inviting Pujara for a drive. He looks to play at it and is beaten. A wicket maiden for Henry.
Length ball outside off, a bit of bounce on it. Pujara lets it through. Good ball that.
Cheteshwar Pujara to bat next.

OUT! Dhawan departs! Length ball outside off, Dhawan stays deep in his crease and makes some room to cut it through the off side. The ball catches an inside edge and crashes onto the stumps. Shikhar goes early and Henry strikes in his first over. What a start for the Kiwis and they are delighted!
Full ball outside off, left alone.
Short ball around the rib-cage of Dhawan, he defends it to the leg side.
Back of a length ball and outside off, Dhawan looks at it and goes after it to play but decides against it.
Matt Henry will bowl from the other end with the cherry.
India off the mark! Full ball around middle and off, Dhawan lunges and pushes it to covers for a single.
Serves it on the same line, Dhawan leaves it for the keeper.
Hurls it outside off, it holds up its line and Shikhar looks to play at it but withdraws his bat to let it go.
Length ball on the sixth stump line. Dhawan sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Superb line outside off, it swings away from Dhawan. He lets it through yet again.
Boult starts with a length ball, swinging away after pitching. Dhawan sees it and lets it through to the keeper.

Kapil Dev rings the bell at Eden Gardens and here we go. All the players and the umpires are walking on to the field. Murali Vijay and Shikhar Dhawan will open the innings for India. Trent Boult will open the bowling proceedings for New Zealand.
All the players are out on the field for their respective National Anthems.

ROSS TAYLOR, NEW ZEALAND SKIPPER says that the main skipper is missing as he is the world's 2nd best player and also adds that he is a bit sick because of fever. (On this match) He says that they will like to step up. (On their last match) He states that they will look to play well today. (On the team changes) He confirms that Jeetan Patel is back replacing Ish Sodhi and Henry Nicholls is in for Kane Williamson. Ends by saying Matt Henry is in too.

VIRAT KOHLI, INDIA SKIPPER says that they will bat first as the wicket looks good also adds that initial overs will be tough to bat as it has grass on it. (On the preparation) He states that the practice session went well and everyone is all excited to play here. (On the momentum) He opines that it will be nice to carry the momentum into this game. (On the change) He says that Shikhar Dhawan replaces KL Rahul and Bhuvneshwar Kumar replaces Umesh Yadav.
TOSS - India win the toss and elect to bat first!

From Kiwis point of view, Kane Williamson is the latest casualty as he is down with a bug and Ross Taylor will lead the side. Mark Craig will also miss the match today. All-in-all, this match at Eden Gardens will be a high-voltage game and full of interesting turn around. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Coming into this match, India will look to win it and seal the series and New Zealand, on the other hand, will look to level it after a defeat in the series opener. Both the teams are going to have a few changes in their playing eleven. KL Rahul is out for India and it will be interesting to see who gets a chance to open alongside Murali Vijay. Kiwis will have a few changes too.
Hello and a warm welcome one and all for the second Test match between India and New Zealand. It is the 250th Test match for India on home soil and the atmosphere is electrifying.
